ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aid training to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.

Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

  • Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  • Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  • Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  • Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  • Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  • Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  • Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Especialista de Planejamento Tributário
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Acompanhamento e análise de alterações na legislação tributária e consultoria interna;

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.

Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.

Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.

This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller

Location: Barra da Tijuca

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;

Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;

Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;

Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;

Support month-end and year-end closing activities;

Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;

Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.

Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Bl.

title: Analista ambiental
description:
Acoem Ambiental | Cliente no Centro do Rio de Janeiro

Posição por tempo determinado – cobertura de férias

A Acoem Ambiental atua com excelência em serviços de monitoramento e gestão ambiental, apoiando clientes na tomada de decisão responsável e sustentável.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Ambiental para atuar junto a um cliente localizado no Centro do Rio de Janeiro , em uma posição por tempo determinado, destinada à cobertura de férias , com atuação técnica consistente, visão analítica e alinhamento aos valores que orientam nosso trabalho: integridade, ousadia e satisfação .

O Papel do Analista Ambiental em nossa Organização

Atuação técnica em projetos de qualidade do ar, emissões atmosféricas e gases de efeito estufa, com foco em análise de dados, conformidade regulatória, estudos ambientais e apoio a processos de licenciamento.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Legislação ambiental aplicada à qualidade do ar, emissões atmosféricas e/ou GEE
  • (CONAMA 506/24, CONAMA 382/06, CONAMA 436/11, NOP-INEA-01, NOP-INEA-52, Resolução INEA/PRES nº 65);
  • Guia Técnico de Qualidade do Ar;
  • Inventários corporativos de gases de efeito estufa (GEE);
  • Licenciamento ambiental com ênfase em emissões atmosféricas e qualidade do ar;
  • Análise de dados de emissões atmosféricas, dados meteorológicos e/ou qualidade do ar;
  • Excel avançado; Power BI; Python e/ou R;
  • Redação técnica clara e objetiva;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.

Responsabilidades

  • Analisar, validar e interpretar dados de monitoramento de emissões e/ou qualidade do ar;
  • Elaborar e avaliar estudos técnicos, relatórios e pareceres;
  • Executar e acompanhar programas de monitoramento ambiental;
  • Analisar dados de inventários de emissão de gases de efeito estufa;
  • Apoiar processos de licenciamento ambiental e atendimento a condicionantes;
  • Desenvolver estudos e procedimentos para gestão, organização e divulgação de dados ambientais;
  • Realizar vistorias técnicas em empresas atendidas pelos programas de controle.

Formação

  • Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou Química.

Benefícios

  • Vale Alimentação de R$ 45,00 por dia;
  • Vale Combustível;
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco (sem custo para o titular; dependentes conforme faixa etária);
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco (sem custo);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass (opcional);
  • Convênio farmácias EcxCard (opcional);
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Bônus anual atrelado à performance.

Nosso Jeito de Trabalhar

Na Acoem Ambiental , valorizamos profissionais que atuam com ética, responsabilidade e visão técnica, independentemente do tempo de permanência, entregando qualidade, consistência e impacto positivo.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Curso Técnico em Meio Ambiente (concluído e reconhecido pelo MEC)

  • Experiência com licenciamento ambiental e atendimento a órgãos fiscalizadores

  • Planejamento e execução de vistorias e auditorias ambientais

Desejáveis:

  • Graduação em Gestão Ambiental, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas correlatas

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description:
1. About Us

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Guided by our core belief—“We help people eat better, live better” —we’re bringing innovation to the global stage and building a better future for consumers and partners alike.

2. Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing and developing assigned accounts, supporting medium-sized chain brands to strengthen cooperation with the platform through brand marketing and promotional activities, contributing to the growth of transaction volume; executing the company’s sales strategy and supporting the achievement of sales targets;
  • Understand the business operations of the brands under responsibility based on their industry characteristics, and assist in developing and implementing food delivery solutions through basic business data analysis;
  • Maintain effective communication with the platform’s delivery team, acting as a liaison between the delivery team and assigned brands to help improve the overall delivery service experience;
  • Actively collect first-hand marketing information, user feedback, and local market insights, and provide practical and actionable suggestions to support business improvements.

3. Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development in the food, restaurant, or consumer goods industry is preferred;
  • Good negotiation and market development skills, strong goal orientation, customer-focused mindset, and willingness to take on challenges;
  • Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications; experience working with reports and charts is required;
  • High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork; proactive and passionate about work;
  • English is mandatory.

4. Why Join Us?

Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Analista de Validação de Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

title: Pessoa Analista de Controles Internos Sr.
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.

2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.

3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.

4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.

description:

  • Estar cursando Ensino Superior em Gastronomia;
  • Ter conhecimento das normas de Segurança de Alimentos;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar das 08h00 às 15h00 ou das 15h00 às 22h00.
  • Paixão por confeitaria e por gastronomia.
  • Comprometido, curiosidade e dedicação, com desejo genuíno de evoluir em um ambiente de excelência.

Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje!

Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.

Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. title: Compliance and AML Counsel
description:
The Compliance and AML Counsel will serve as a key member of the compliance function, advising internal stakeholders on a broad range of regulatory compliance matters, with a particular focus on anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crime prevention. 

RESPONSABILITIES

i. Supporting the design, implementation, and enhancement of Maha Capital's AML and sanctions compliance programs in accordance with applicable laws and regulatory guidance. The role involves conducting legal research and analysis on AML, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Know Your Customer (KYC), and sanctions requirements, as well as preparing and reviewing compliance policies, procedures, and internal controls in different jurisdictions.

ii. Responding to regulatory examinations, enforcement actions, and investigations by financial regulators and law enforcement agencies.

iii. Drafting and negotiating compliance-related provisions in commercial agreements, conducting risk assessments and gap analyses of existing compliance frameworks, and advising internal business units on regulatory/ compliance developments affecting the company and its operations.

iv. Supporting due diligence efforts in connection with Maha Capital's and its subsidiaries investments, credit and corporate transactions.

 QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor’s degree in law.

ii. Minimum 4 years of experience

iii. Language: English, fluent / Spanish, advanced

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Srong knowledge of compliance, AML and sanctions laws.

ii. Excellent legal research, writing, and analytical skills are essential, as is the ability to communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly to internal stakeholders at all levels.

iii. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in different jurisdictions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

iv. Strong working knowledge of major anti-corruption and anti-bribery frameworks, including: U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), UK Bribery Act, Brazilian Anti-Corruption Law (Law No. 12,846/2013 – Clean Company Act) and related regulations

v. Ability to interpret and apply anti-corruption principles across multiple jurisdictions where the Company operates.

vi. Experience advising on interactions with public officials, third-party risk management, and internal controls designed to prevent bribery and corruption.

vii. Capacity to align local compliance requirements with international best practices and global compliance standards

SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

title: Podcast Audio Editor
description:
Company Description

Sofia Health® is an online marketplace that connects clients with providers across a wide range of health and wellness services, offering everything from 1:1 sessions to wellness products. The platform empowers individuals to access both conventional and complementary care in one convenient location, giving them greater choice and control over their health journey. Providers can grow their practices by offering a variety of services and programs through Sofia Health. The company also partners with employers and government agencies, including VA Health Care Systems, to deliver accessible, integrative wellness programs. Sofia Health is dedicated to making wellness personalized, effective, and universally accessible.

Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Podcast Audio Editor. The Podcast Audio Editor will be responsible for editing podcast audio files, enhancing sound quality, implementing sound design, adding music, and ensuring overall quality control for each episode. The role involves working closely with the content team to maintain brand consistency and meet deadlines efficiently.

Responsibilities
  • Edit raw podcast audio into polished, broadcast-ready episodes
  • Remove filler words, false starts, redundancies, and off-topic tangents
  • Improve pacing, clarity, and flow without changing the speaker’s voice or intent
  • Restructure sections when needed based on how questions were answered
  • Insert intro/outro, sponsor reads, disclaimers, or updates when required
  • Follow embedded audio notes and written instructions carefully
  • Deliver clean final WAV/MP3 files on deadline
  • Produce 3–4 short clips per episode for marketing use
  • Support up to two rounds of edits per episode when requested
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience editing long-form podcasts (interview or narrative style)
  • Strong editorial judgment — you know what to cut and why
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely
  • Comfortable working with physician and expert-level conversations
  • Fast, reliable turnaround times
  • Clear, professional communication
  • Familiarity with tools like Descript, Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Logic, or similar

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Audio Editing, including cleaning, trimming, and fine-tuning audio files
  • Experience with Sound Design and the ability to enhance audio with effects and background elements
  • Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content
  • Strong Editing skills paired with attention to detail to maintain high-quality output
  • Familiarity with audio editing software such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar tools
  • Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with teams, and meet deadlines
  • Experience in podcast production is a plus
  • Background in audio engineering, media production, or a related field is beneficial

title: LATAM-Focused Research Intern

About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America’s, particularly Argentina’s, macroeconomic and financial environment . This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.g., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;
  • Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com foco nos indicadores operacionais Identificar, estruturar e priorizar alavancas de resultado, avaliando impacto, viabilidade e retorno financeiro;
  • Desenvolver análises estratégicas integradas, conectando desempenho financeiro, comercial e operacional dos ativos;
  • Atuar em parceria com as Regionais e Shoppings, traduzindo análises em direcionamentos táticos claros e acionáveis;
  • Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
  • Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Analista em áreas estratégicas;
  • Vivência em análises financeiras e operacionais avançadas, com leitura crítica de indicadores de resultado;
  • Domínio de indicadores como: margem, custos, vendas, SSS, rentabilidade e performance operacional;
  • Experiência na construção de recomendações estratégicas e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva;
  • Habilidade para traduzir dados complexos em insights claros;
  • Excel avançado e experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (ex.: Power BI, similares).

O Que Temos Para Você

title: Estagiário de engenharia
description:
Sobre a DTX

A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.

Sobre o trabalho

Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de engenharia.

O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação técnica de futuros engenheiros especialistas em trem de pouso em processos de MRO.

O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de " job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de trens de pouso de forma global.

1. Suporte de projeto e engenharia

Tarefas:

  • Apoiar os engenheiros na análise e revisão das especificações do projeto.
  • Auxiliar na avaliação de desenhos, esquemas e especificações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Saiber como as equipes de engenharia dão suporte ao processo de produção e manutenção.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Compreensão dos princípios de design para componentes aeroespaciais
  • Familiaridade com software CAD e desenhos de engenharia
  • Técnicas de resolução de problemas em engenharia aeroespacial

2. Análise de Tensão e Teste de Material

Tarefas de rotação:

  • Auxiliar em cálculos de análise de tensão ou simulações para componentes do trem de pouso.
  • Participar de testes de materiais, como testes de tração, fadiga e corrosão.
  • Observar o uso da Análise de Elementos Finitos (FEA) para componentes do trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Princípios básicos de estresse, tensão e ciência dos materiais
  • Uso de ferramentas de simulação (por exemplo, FEA)
  • Aplicação de testes de materiais em engenharia aeronáutica

3. Conformidade Regulatória e Documentação

Tarefas:

  • Saber mais sobre o papel dos órgãos reguladores (FAA, ANAC, EASA...) nas operações de MRO.
  • Auxiliar na documentação dos procedimentos de manutenção, inspeção e reparo.
  • Entender como manter a conformidade com os padrões de aeronavegabilidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Familiaridade com normas e certificações regulatórias
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento e rastreamento de documentação
  • Atenção aos protocolos de conformidade e aeronavegabilidade

4. Gestão e Coordenação de Projetos

Tarefas:

  • Acompanhar os gerentes de projeto para entender o agendamento e a alocação de recursos.
  • Auxiliar no gerenciamento de cronogramas e documentação de projetos para projetos de revisão de trens de pouso.
  • Ajudar na coordenação entre as equipes de produção, engenharia e qualidade.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de gerenciamento de tempo e coordenação de projetos
  • Compreensão das ferramentas e técnicas de gerenciamento de projetos
  • Comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental

5. Suporte de campo e interação com o cliente

Tarefas:

  • Auxiliar na prestação de suporte técnico aos clientes (companhias aéreas, militares, etc.) quando necessário.
  • Observar as visitas dos clientes e ajude a explicar os processos de reparo.
  • Participar da análise de causa raiz para problemas recorrentes de trem de pouso.

Habilidades adquiridas:

  • Habilidades de comunicação com o cliente em um contexto técnico
  • Resolução de problemas e análise de causa raiz
  • Coordenação entre engenharia e atendimento ao cliente

Requisitos e informações da vaga:

  • O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em Engenharia.
  • A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
  • Duração inicial de 06 meses podendo ser renovado por mais 06 meses com chance de efetivação ao final.
  • O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.

title: Senior Supply Chain Analyst
description:
The Senior Supply Chain Analyst will be responsible for managing procurement activities, supplier performance, contracts, and materials flow to support operational demands. The role requires close interaction with operations, engineering, logistics, finance, and external suppliers, ensuring timely delivery, cost optimization, and compliance with internal and external requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Manage procurement processes from requisition to delivery, including RFQs, negotiations, purchase orders, and follow-up
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local and international suppliers
  • Analyze costs, lead times, and supply risks to support sourcing decisions
  • Support contract management, including commercial terms, service levels, and compliance
  • Coordinate logistics, importation, and exportation processes when applicable
  • Monitor supplier performance and propose continuous improvement actions
  • Support inventory control, critical materials analysis, and stock optimization
  • Prepare reports, KPIs, and dashboards to support management decision-making
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable regulations

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken)
  • Strong experience in procurement and supply chain operations, preferably in industrial, offshore, oil & gas, or logistics environments
  • Microsoft Office proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and SharePoint
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience with ERP systems is a plus (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, SAP, Oracle)

title: Key Account Manager
description:
En Iquall Networks somos una empresa global que desarrolla soluciones de automatización para las redes de telecomunicaciones más importantes del mundo. Buscamos un/a Key Account Manager en Río de Janeiro, Brasil, con visión, energía y capacidad de ejecución para ayudarnos a seguir creciendo.

Queremos personas con iniciativa, criterio y autonomía; capaces de involucrarse, escuchar al cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y trabajar codo con codo con nuestros equipos técnicos para generar oportunidades reales.

No importa si no tienes diez años de experiencia: lo que más valoramos es tu actitud, tu forma de pensar y tus ganas de marcar la diferencia. Eso sí, necesitamos que cuentes con experiencia previa en entornos comerciales o tecnológicos.

¿Qué harás?

  • Ser el punto de contacto principal entre Iquall y los operadores de telecomunicaciones.
  • Acompañar el ciclo comercial completo: desde la detección y generación de oportunidades hasta el seguimiento postventa.
  • Participar activamente en la elaboración de propuestas, respuestas a RFPs y presentaciones de alto impacto.
  • Coordinar reuniones con distintas áreas del cliente (Tecnología, Operaciones, Compras, B2B, etc.).
  • Construir relaciones de largo plazo, basadas en la confianza y un entendimiento profundo del negocio.
  • Identificar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con nuestros equipos de producto, preventa y delivery.
  • Aportar ideas y opiniones sobre estrategia comercial y condiciones.

Qué buscamos en ti

  • Experiencia previa en áreas comerciales, técnicas o consultivas dentro del sector Telco o tecnológico.
  • Capacidad de autogestión y autonomía: aquí nadie te va a empujar; necesitamos que tomes la iniciativa.
  • Ganas de aprender rápido, colaborar intensamente y asumir retos variados.
  • Claridad para comunicar ideas complejas a distintos perfiles de interlocutores.
  • Espíritu colaborativo: no trabajas solo/a, trabajas con un equipo que te respalda.
  • Inglés imprescindible.
  • Buen criterio, inteligencia práctica y pasión por resolver problemas reales.

Qué ofrecemos

  • Formar parte de una empresa ágil, global y en pleno crecimiento.
  • Acceso a proyectos con los principales operadores del mercado.
  • Un entorno que valora las ideas nuevas, el compromiso y la capacidad de ejecución.
  • Modalidad 100% remota, con flexibilidad y autonomía.
  • Espacios reales para aprender, aportar y desarrollarte profesionalmente.

Si te ves reflejado/a en esta propuesta y quieres trabajar con impacto real en el futuro de las telecomunicaciones, escríbenos.

Queremos conocerte.

title: Supervisor Trade Marketing Canal (Temporário) - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:

  • Desenvolver relatórios de resultados das ações promocionais, com impacto de investimento, potencial de alavancagem e ROI;

  • Conhecimento funcional em Microsoft Azure (nível necessário para publicação, monitoramento e integrações básicas).

  • Experiências anteriores com agentes/LLMs além do Copilot Studio.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

  • Desenvolver plano de negócios anual, determinando metas de vendas e ações para o atingimento da cota estabelecida; alcançar e superar cota através da carteira designada;

  • Gerar vendas para novos e atuais clientes enquanto garante alta satisfação.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;

Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;

Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;

Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;

Support month-end and year-end closing activities;

Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;

Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.

Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

title: TECNICO(A) IMPLANTAÇÃO II
description:
A Convergint é uma empresa global, fundada em 2001 nos arredores de Chicago, que atua como integradora de sistemas especializada em segurança eletrônica, automação predial, áudio e vídeo, sistemas de incêndio e life safety, com objetivo de ser o melhor provedor de serviços para os nossos clientes.

Atualmente, contamos com mais de 11 mil colaboradores e estamos presentes em mais de 225 escritórios ao redor do mundo.

Descritivo:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Implantação II para atuar na implantação, instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas e equipamentos técnicos, contribuindo diretamente para a execução de projetos em campo. O(a) profissional será responsável por realizar montagens, testes funcionais, integrações de sistemas e comissionamentos, garantindo o correto funcionamento das soluções implantadas.

Principais atividades:

  • Passagem de cabos de dados e elétricos em tubulações, canaletas e caixas de passagem para interligação de equipamentos, paineis e dispositivos eletrônicos realizando trabalhos em altura (NR35).
  • Instalação e conexão de dispositivos de BMS, Security e SDAI tais como: cameras, sensores, detectores, atuadores, eletroímãs, leitores, módulos e outros dispositivos eletrônicos.
  • Conhecimento em montagem de RCE, montagem e organização de rack de cabeamento, instalação e conectorização de patch panel, switches e interligação de dispositivos de rede.
  • Leitura de diagramas, projetos de instalação e bayfaces.
  • Elaboração de relatório das atividades executadas em campo (RDO).
  • Disponibilidade de viagem para atender projetos em outros estados, seguindo a política de viagens estabelecido pela empresa.
  • Conhecer, entender e seguir as políticas e procedimentos do Sistema de Gestão da Convergint com foco em Qualidade, Segurança da Informação Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno.
  • Propor melhorias para os processos e serviços visando manter e melhorar continuamente a Qualidade dos serviços, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Compliance / Antissuborno, incluindo participação na identificação e determinação de ações para minimização e controle dos riscos relacionados.

Habilidades:

  • Manuseio de ferramentas elétricas (parafusadeira, furadeira, esmerilhadeira);
  • Conectorização de cabos (RJ45, Keystone e Terminais elétricos);
  • Instalação de Dispositivos eletrônicos de BMS, SDAI e SECURITY;
  • Montagem de Rede de cabeamento estruturado (RCE);
  • Diferenciais: Certificações de fabricantes de sistemas de BMS, SDAI, RCE e SECURITY.

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor's degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we're reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you'll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
About you

You are a senior-level DevOps Engineer who enjoys designing, automating, and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms. You thrive in complex environments where infrastructure reliability, automation, and security are critical. You're comfortable owning infrastructure decisions end to end and collaborating closely with architects and engineering teams to enable high-performing, cloud-native solutions.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in senior or staff-level DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Professional certifications such as Azure DevOps, Terraform, or similar (preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and automation tools such as env0 (or equivalent).
  • Strong proficiency with Azure services, including networking, Managed Identities, Key Vault, App Services, AKS, Cosmos DB, Cognitive Search, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Deep expertise in identity and access management, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
  • Advanced skills in CI/CD automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and related toolchains.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and automation scripting using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Datadog and Azure Application Insights.
  • Proven track record contributing to or leading complex cloud infrastructure initiatives in fast-paced or large-scale environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and env0. Automate deployments to ensure scalability, consistency, and security.
  • Manage Azure networking, databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB), and identity tools (Entra ID, Okta). Ensure robust access controls and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Embed best practices for testing, versioning, and automated releases.
  • Implement observability using Datadog and Azure Application Insights. Monitor performance, resolve issues proactively, and optimize cost and reliability.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to align on infrastructure standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.
